name: Lazeez Cafeteria & Fast Food Restaurant
why_it_matters: The only formally listed eatery at Doodhpathri itself — most travellers picnic from roadside stalls, but Lazeez is the one walk-in option with a real kitchen. Open through the day, sits near the Ziyarat Sharief Sheikh Noor on the main approach.
insider_tip: Doodhpathri shuts at sunset — Lazeez closes around 8pm and there's no dinner service in the meadow. Order before 6pm if you've miscalculated the drive back to Srinagar.
signature_address: Near Ziyarat Sharief Sheikh Noor, Main Doodhpathri, Budgam, Jammu and Kashmir 191111
